Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI website builder skill.
- Provides tools for creating, modifying, and troubleshooting SAAS-based websites.
- Supports page generation (HTML/CSS/JS, Twig), data queries, and content management via user-supplied MCP services.
- Enables workflows such as new website creation, site migration, and enterprise site editing.
- Enforces strict coding, template, and data validation rules to ensure site quality and security.
